sources.entry: SigNoz | OpenTelemetry-native observability with logs, traces and metrics

summary.one_liner: SigNoz is an OpenTelemetry-native observability platform that combines logs, metrics, traces, alerts, and dashboards in one tool, available as a managed cloud service or self-hosted.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes SigNoz as an open-source observability platform built on OpenTelemetry, meant to replace fragmented monitoring stacks. It covers APM overview (latency, error rate, throughput, Apdex, top endpoints), log management with a visual query builder, and metrics dashboards built with Query Builder, PromQL, or ClickHouse SQL. It also includes Kubernetes and host infrastructure monitoring, distributed tracing with flamegraphs and waterfalls, trace funnels, LLM and AI observability, and exception and alert tracking. An MCP server is offered for bringing telemetry into coding agents. The community edition runs on Docker, Kubernetes, or Linux.
use_cases: monitor production service latency and errors
centralize logs, traces and metrics in one tool
observe LLM apps and RAG pipelines
how_to_run: Deploy the community edition with Docker, Kubernetes, or Linux (see the 'Install SigNoz' docs linked from the README)
Or use Foundry for self-hosting as listed in the README
Or sign up for SigNoz Cloud for a managed workspace (30-day free trial)
Instrument applications with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, or language SDKs to send data
notable: Built on OpenTelemetry with open standards for instrumentation
Single columnar database designed for high-cardinality data
Correlates logs, traces, metrics, and exceptions without switching tools
Noz AI assistant and MCP server for agent-driven investigation (Cloud only for Noz)
caveats: Noz is available only on SigNoz Cloud
Enterprise features such as RBAC, custom retention, and BYOC are in paid Enterprise tiers
Cloud pricing is usage-based starting at $49, and the 30-day trial is for Cloud only
